# Mathlify

> Mathlify is a collection of free, client-side, privacy-focused online calculators covering finance, fitness, mathematics, number theory, base conversion, statistics, and science. No ads, no user tracking, no sign-up required.

Website: https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/

## Calculators & Tools

### Financial
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/mortgage-calculator.html): Estimates monthly principal & interest (P&I) payments, total interest paid, and full loan amortization schedule using `M = P[r(1+r)^n] / [(1+r)^n - 1]`.
- [Amortization Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/amortization-calculator.html): Calculates monthly loan payment breakdowns, principal reduction, and yearly/monthly amortization schedules with extra payment simulations.

### Health & Fitness
- [BMI Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/bmi-calculator.html): Computes Body Mass Index across metric (`kg/m²`) and imperial (`lbs/in² × 703`) units with WHO category classifications (Underweight, Normal, Overweight, Obese).
- [Age Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/age-calculator.html): Calculates exact age in years, months, days, hours, minutes, and days until the next birthday.
- [Calorie & Macro Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/calorie-calculator.html): Calculates BMR, TDEE, and macronutrient targets with dual Indian (ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA & Asian-Indian BMI cutoffs) and Global (Mifflin/WHO) standards, interactive 70+ food plate builder, and snack burn estimator.

### Mathematics
- [Time Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/time-calculator.html): Adds or subtracts durations in days, hours, minutes, and seconds, projects future/past calendar dates and times, and calculates exact elapsed duration between two timestamps with total unit breakdowns.
- [Scientific Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/scientific-calculator.html): Full-featured scientific calculation engine supporting trigonometry (sin, cos, tan), inverse trig, logarithms (log, ln), exponents, powers, factorial, and constants (π, e).
- [Percentage Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/percentage-calculator.html): Calculates percentages, percentage increase/decrease, what percentage X is of Y, and percentage difference.
- [Exponent Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/exponent-calculator.html): Computes base raised to any exponent `b^x`, including fractional and negative powers with step explanations.
- [Root Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/root-calculator.html): Computes square roots, cube roots, and nth roots `ⁿ√x` with precision control.
- [Log Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/log-calculator.html): Calculates logarithms with custom bases `log_b(x)`, natural logarithms `ln(x)`, and common logarithms `log10(x)`.
- [Quadratic Formula Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/quadratic-calculator.html): Solves quadratic equations `ax² + bx + c = 0`, calculating the discriminant `Δ = b² - 4ac`, real and complex roots, and vertex coordinates.
- [Random Number Generator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/random-calculator.html): Generates cryptographically strong pseudo-random integers and floats within custom ranges with optional non-repeating lists.
- [Scientific Notation Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/scientific-notation-calculator.html): Converts standard numbers into scientific notation `a × 10^b`, engineering notation, and performs arithmetic operations.
- [Big Number Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/big-number-calculator.html): Performs arbitrary-precision arithmetic (addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, modulo, exponents) on extremely large numbers without precision loss.

### Geometry
- [Triangle Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/triangle-calculator.html): Solves triangles using SSS, SAS, ASA, or Base & Height. Computes area (Heron's formula), perimeter, angles, inradius, and circumradius.
- [Volume Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/volume-calculator.html): Calculates the volume of spheres, cylinders, cones, rectangular boxes, cubes, and pyramids with liquid capacity conversions.
- [Slope Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/slope-calculator.html): Calculates slope `m = rise/run`, angle of inclination, percent grade, slope-intercept equation `y = mx + b`, and perpendicular line slopes.
- [Area Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/area-calculator.html): Calculates area and perimeter for 2D shapes including rectangles, circles, triangles, trapezoids, parallelograms, ellipses, and circular sectors.
- [Distance Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/distance-calculator.html): Computes straight-line Euclidean distance in 2D and 3D coordinate space, midpoint, and geographic distance using the Haversine equation.
- [Circle Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/circle-calculator.html): Omnidirectional circle solver given radius, diameter, circumference, or area; also calculates arc length and sector area.
- [Surface Area Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/surface-area-calculator.html): Calculates total, lateral, and base surface areas of spheres, cylinders, cones, rectangular prisms, cubes, and capsules.
- [Pythagorean Theorem Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/pythagorean-calculator.html): Solves `a² + b² = c²` for hypotenuse or legs with exact radical simplification, step-by-step proofs, and integer triples.
- [Right Triangle Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/right-triangle-calculator.html): Solves right triangles given any two parameters, computing all sides, angles, area, perimeter, and trigonometric ratios.

### Number Theory
- [Factor Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/factor-calculator.html): Finds all integer factors, factor pairs, prime factorization, and prime/composite classification for any number.
- [LCM Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/lcm-calculator.html): Computes the Least Common Multiple (LCM) for two or more integers using prime factorization or division method.
- [GCF Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/gcf-calculator.html): Computes the Greatest Common Factor (GCF / GCD / HCF) of multiple numbers using the Euclidean algorithm.
- [Ratio Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/ratio-calculator.html): Simplifies ratios `A : B`, finds equivalent proportions `A : B = C : D`, and scales recipes or dimensions.

### Base Conversion
- [Binary Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/binary-calculator.html): Converts between Binary (Base-2), Decimal (Base-10), Hexadecimal (Base-16), and Octal (Base-8), and executes binary bitwise operations (AND, OR, XOR, NOT, Shift).
- [Hex Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/hex-calculator.html): Converts between Hexadecimal, Decimal, Binary, and ASCII text, and performs arithmetic in base 16.

### Science & Statistics
- [Percent Error Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/percent-error-calculator.html): Calculates experimental error using `|Experimental - Theoretical| / Theoretical × 100%`.
- [Half-Life Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/half-life-calculator.html): Solves radioactive decay formulas `N(t) = N0 × (1/2)^(t / t_half)` for remaining quantity, initial quantity, time elapsed, or half-life duration.
- [Matrix Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/matrix-calculator.html): Computes matrix addition, subtraction, multiplication, determinants, inverses, and transposes for 2x2 and 3x3 matrices.
- [Rounding Calculator](https://sayandeepmajumdar.github.io/mathlify/tools/round-calculator.html): Rounds numbers to nearest decimal places, significant figures, fractions, or ceiling/floor integers.
